item.title: How calls are recorded and processed
item.body: At the start of a call you hear how the call is recorded and processed. If you prefer not to be recorded, say so and you will be offered the approved alternative. The assistant tells you accurately whether transcription or automated processing continues; it never describes a call as unrecorded while any recording or processing continues.
